tasks.task: Browse the creative works section.
tasks.expected: The creative works section loads correctly, displaying a list of user-created content with images and descriptions that are relevant to inspiring imagination.

tasks.task: Submit a new idea via the share ideas form.
tasks.expected: The form submits successfully, the new idea appears in the shared ideas section, and a confirmation message is displayed.

tasks.task: Participate in a discussion by posting a comment.
tasks.expected: The comment is visible under the appropriate discussion topic, with the correct username and timestamp noted.

tasks.task: Navigate through the main pages (Home, Creative Works, Share Ideas, Discussions, Interactions) using the website's navigation menu.
tasks.expected: Each page loads correctly without layout issues, ensuring intuitive navigation and seamless transitions.

tasks.task: Interact with another user by sending a message.
tasks.expected: The message is delivered successfully, with a notification displayed to the recipient indicating a new message has been received.

tasks.task: Verify that the website uses 'azure mist' as the background color and 'dark slate blue' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
tasks.expected: The website has a background color of 'azure mist' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark slate blue', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

tasks.task: In the browse explorer, click the #nature tag chip and the #abstract tag chip with no category selected.
tasks.expected: Exactly four works show — Clockwork Garden, Ink Tempest, Origami Tide, Rust & Roses — with the counter reading 4 of 8; Origami Tide, which carries both tags, appears only once.

tasks.task: Select the Papercraft category and the #animals tag chip together in the browse explorer.
tasks.expected: Only Paper Dragons remains visible — works matching just the category or just the tag are filtered out.

tasks.task: Use the sort-by-likes option in the browse explorer.
tasks.expected: Midnight Library comes first, and Origami Tide appears directly above Rust & Roses — the 95-likes tie broken alphabetically by title.

tasks.task: From the site's main navigation, open the section for browsing creative works without touching any filter.
tasks.expected: All eight seeded works are visible on first load and the live counter reflects 8 of 8.

tasks.task: Open the discussions area and post a new comment that says 'Love this place'.
tasks.expected: The comment 'Love this place' appears in the discussion area right after posting.

tasks.task: On the Spark Score page, use the prefill picker to choose Ink Tempest.
tasks.expected: Views, likes, and comments fill with 430, 60, and 3, the score reads 178.0, and the tier shows Blaze.

tasks.task: On the Spark Score page, type 100 into the views field, 10 into likes, and 4 into comments.
tasks.expected: The score reads 50.0 and the tier shows Flame — a score of exactly 50 lands in Flame, not Ember.

tasks.task: Type -5 into the likes field on the Spark Score page.
tasks.expected: A polite validation message appears and the score area never shows NaN or a broken value.

tasks.task: Use the prefill picker to choose Glass Comet, then change the comments field to 27.
tasks.expected: The prefilled score of 785.0 updates live to 835.0 without any submit step.

tasks.task: Use the sort-by-likes option in the browse explorer.
tasks.expected: Midnight Library comes first, and Origami Tide appears directly above Rust & Roses — the 95-likes tie broken alphabetically by title.

tasks.task: On Nebula Whale's card in the browse explorer, click the heart, then click it again.
tasks.expected: The like count goes from 320 to 321 and back to 320, and Nebula Whale does not remain on the Favorites page.

tasks.task: Click the heart on Glass Comet's card, then open the Favorites page.
tasks.expected: Glass Comet's like count reads 276 and it appears on the Favorites page under a Sculpture group.

tasks.task: Open the Favorites page before hearting anything.
tasks.expected: Instead of a blank area, a playful note mentioning a spark appears.

tasks.task: Click the heart on Rust & Roses' card, then select the #urban tag chip in the explorer.
tasks.expected: Rust & Roses is the only work shown, still marked as hearted with a like count of 96.

tasks.task: Select the Papercraft category and the #animals tag chip together in the browse explorer.
tasks.expected: Only Paper Dragons remains visible — works matching just the category or just the tag are filtered out.

tasks.task: On the Communities page, use the create form to submit a new community named 'Nature Collective'.
tasks.expected: The form rejects it with a friendly message about the name already being taken, and the communities list still shows only the two seeded groups.

tasks.task: Open Nature Collective's community page.
tasks.expected: Its theme gallery shows exactly three works: Clockwork Garden, Origami Tide, and Rust & Roses.

tasks.task: Open Space Dreamers' community page and click the join button.
tasks.expected: The member count moves from 6 to 7 and the pinned discussion thread now accepts posts.

tasks.task: Open the Communities page and look at how each community's theme is shown.
tasks.expected: Themes appear as tags with a leading #, e.g. #nature for Nature Collective and #space for Space Dreamers.

tasks.task: On the Spark Score page, type 100 into the views field, 10 into likes, and 4 into comments.
tasks.expected: The score reads 50.0 and the tier shows Flame — a score of exactly 50 lands in Flame, not Ember.

tasks.task: Open the Weekly Spotlight page without doing anything else first.
tasks.expected: The podium reads Glass Comet (61) first, Clockwork Garden (45) second, Paper Dragons (45) third — the 45-45 tie resolved alphabetically by title, and not the all-time leader Midnight Library on top.

tasks.task: Find Midnight Library on the Weekly Spotlight page.
tasks.expected: It sits 7th with 8 weekly likes and is shown as having slid 6 places from its all-time rank of 1.

tasks.task: Scroll through the full Weekly Spotlight list.
tasks.expected: All eight works appear exactly once each, with Ink Tempest in last place.

tasks.task: In the browse explorer, click the heart on Paper Dragons' card, then open the Weekly Spotlight page.
tasks.expected: Paper Dragons now stands second with 46 weekly likes, pushing Clockwork Garden (45) down to third.

tasks.task: On Nebula Whale's card in the browse explorer, click the heart, then click it again.
tasks.expected: The like count goes from 320 to 321 and back to 320, and Nebula Whale does not remain on the Favorites page.

tasks.task: In Nature Collective's Wild Growth challenge, try to enter Clockwork Garden again.
tasks.expected: The repeat entry is blocked with a message and the challenge still lists exactly two entries.

tasks.task: In Nature Collective's Wild Growth challenge, try to enter Nebula Whale, then enter Rust & Roses.
tasks.expected: Nebula Whale is turned away with a message — no #nature among its tags — while Rust & Roses goes through, leaving the challenge with exactly three entries: Clockwork Garden, Origami Tide, and Rust & Roses.

tasks.task: Use the close-and-crown action on the Wild Growth challenge.
tasks.expected: The challenge flips to closed and announces Clockwork Garden as champion — its 45 weekly likes beat Origami Tide's 19.

tasks.task: Close the Wild Growth challenge, then open the browse explorer and find Clockwork Garden's card.
tasks.expected: A champion badge now appears on Clockwork Garden's card in the explorer.

tasks.task: On the Communities page, use the create form to submit a new community named 'Nature Collective'.
tasks.expected: The form rejects it with a friendly message about the name already being taken, and the communities list still shows only the two seeded groups.

tasks.task: Open the artists insights page.
tasks.expected: Sana Okafor is ranked first with an average Spark Score of 721.5 and Theo Voss is last with 409.5.

tasks.task: Scroll through the artists insights page.
tasks.expected: Exactly four artists appear, each listed once, and each credited with 2 works.

tasks.task: Find Mira Chen's card on the artists insights page.
tasks.expected: Her total views read 2.1k — the 2140 total shown compact, not as a raw number.

tasks.task: Open the activity feed on a fresh load.
tasks.expected: Exactly three already-read entries appear in order — Wild Growth challenge opened (3 days ago) on top, then Space Dreamers community created (5 days ago), then Nebula Whale featured (8 days ago) — and the bell shows no unread count.

tasks.task: In the browse explorer, click the heart on Nebula Whale's card, then check the bell and open the activity feed.
tasks.expected: The bell shows 1 unread before opening; the feed's top entry is the fresh heart on Nebula Whale above the three seeded ones, and the unread indicator clears after viewing.

tasks.task: Open the activity feed and click the filter chip for heart events before giving any hearts.
tasks.expected: No heart events exist yet, so a playful note mentioning a spark appears instead of a blank area, and the seeded non-heart entries stay hidden while that filter is active.
